name: Parched
body:
Type curse; Save Will DC 15 negates, Fort DC 15 to avoid effects; Onset 1 hour; Frequency 1/hour

Effect

This variant of the ravenous curse causes extreme thirst. A gallon of water slakes his thirst until the next failed save. If the victim does not drink within 10 minutes of a failed save, dehydration sets in, and he must succeed at a Constitution check to avoid taking nonlethal damage.
